# Daggerheart SRD System JSON

> Machine-readable JSON-LD 1.1 reference corpus for the Daggerheart System Reference Document 2.0, with JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation. 1,539 records preserve source wording, typed fields, graph links, and line-level provenance.

Attribution: This document, including the Witherwild Campaign Frame, is considered Public Game Content per the Darrington Press Community Gaming License. © 2026 Critical Role LLC. All rights reserved. For more information, please visit www.darringtonpress.com/license.

## Entry points

- [Human-readable explorer](https://cheeleong.dev/daggerheart-system-json/)
- [Full corpus context](https://cheeleong.dev/daggerheart-system-json/llms-full.txt): complete text projection
- [Aggregate manifest](https://cheeleong.dev/daggerheart-system-json/objects/daggerheart-system-data.jsonld)
- [Single-file bundle](https://cheeleong.dev/daggerheart-system-json/objects/daggerheart-system-data.bundle.jsonld)
- [Search index](https://cheeleong.dev/daggerheart-system-json/objects/search-index.json)
- [Collection index](https://cheeleong.dev/daggerheart-system-json/objects/collection-index.json)
- [JSON-LD context](https://cheeleong.dev/daggerheart-system-json/systems/context.jsonld)
- [Vocabulary terms](https://cheeleong.dev/daggerheart-system-json/vocab/terms.json)

## Collections

Raw records use `objects/<collection>/<slug>.jsonld`; indexable HTML counterparts use `records/<collection>/<slug>/`. Every JSON-LD record carries `htmlPage`.

- sources: 1 Source records
- domains: 10 Domain records
- classes: 13 CharacterClass records
- subclasses: 26 Subclass records
- ancestries: 25 Ancestry records
- communities: 15 Community records
- transformations: 6 Transformation records
- beastforms: 24 Beastform records
- weapons: 358 Weapon records
- armor: 76 Armor records
- items: 120 Item records
- consumables: 120 Consumable records
- adversaries: 264 Adversary records
- environments: 47 Environment records
- domain-cards: 210 DomainCard records
- rules: 224 Rule records
